sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original premium wuxia pixel-art SKILL CONCEPT REVIEW SHEET, not runtime sprites, not a sprite atlas. Landscape high resolution, preferably 3072x2048 or highest available. Warm pale parchment board, restrained dark red headings, fine separators, extremely clear generous cell spacing. Header CAI BANG / FIRE ARTS and subtitle CONCEPT ONLY - PENDING APPROVAL. Five columns: CAST / BUILDUP / RELEASE / IMPACT / GAME SCALE (APPROX). Each skill occupies one horizontal row, exact Vietnamese name and ASCII ID as row label. Cast/build/release/impact are enlarged readable pixel-art pose/effect studies, with no heavy background scenery. Last column is a small square top-down stone arena vignette with a much smaller hero, multiple visible enemies and sparse VFX to judge approximate scale. This final column is an illustration, not an actual game screenshot.
IDENTITY LOCK: Reference 1 is the primary approved runtime Cái Bang character atlas; Reference 2 is director character design guidance. Same expressive oversized head, dark brown/black high ponytail tied with red ribbons, red layered martial tunic and sash, ivory crossing collar and forearm wraps, dark trousers, brown shoes. Approximately 44px body at logical game scale on 80px canvas. Preserve original costume, hair, head/body proportions, face, weapon design and character identity throughout. No armor, no hat, no beard, no long robes, no redesign. Palm styles UNARMED with open hands; staff styles use the same plain brown wooden staff, consistent length. Elevated orthographic three-quarter 2D overworld view even in attack poses; never cinematic side-scroller. Reference 3 provides shared pixel style and muted enemy silhouettes; reference 4 provides arena context only.
ART: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, fine dark warm outlines, stepped highlights, richly shaded chibi costume, NO blur, NO smooth vector art, NO 3D. Fire red outer edges, orange body, small yellow/gold white-hot core; Chinese serpentine dragon faces with horns/whiskers readable in negative-space flame ribbons, never a full opaque animal blocking the scene. Martial clarity before spectacle. Hero head, feet and nearby enemy silhouettes remain visible. Directional forward attacks point screen-right consistently. Dragon flourishes are purely visual, must not imply extra hits/targets or homing. No giant circles, screen-filling explosions, decorative magic sigils, targeting cursor, UI mockup panels, new character design, bogus mechanics numbers. Interpret each stated mechanic literally. Sequential cells are concept key moments, NOT animation frames and NOT multiple simultaneous casts. No production frame counts or timing claims.
SHEET 01 - PALM / PROJECTILE & SHOCKWAVE. THREE rows:
1. Hỏa Vân Chưởng / hoa_van_chuong. Actual behavior: THREE rapid separate straight non-homing fire projectiles, aimed once toward nearest enemy at release. Cast: one-palm forward stance. Build: compact coal-orange hand flame, no charge delay implied. Release: three clearly separated small flame-palm bolts along a straight lane, lightly shaped like palm/dragon snouts, numbered 1 2 3 visually if needed; don't merge into one huge dragon. Impact: crisp small fan-shaped ember splash per bolt, no AoE or burn puddle. Game vignette keeps all bolts small and enemy feet visible.
2. Cuồng Long Loạn Vũ / cuong_long_loan_vu. Actual behavior: ONE fireball that explodes on collision and burns an area. NOT a multi-hit palm combo. Cast: both arms gather then palm release. Build: tight red-gold dragon curl coiled inside ONE compact fireball. Release: ONE dragon-coiled fireball traveling straight, no homing, no multiple dragon missiles. Impact: low outward licks of fire and three curling dragon-head flame silhouettes within ONE bounded splash area; sparse lingering burn flickers, an open center and ground visible; never depict extra physical attacks.
3. Phi Long Tại Thiên / phi_long_tai_thien. Spec only; no implemented range/timing. Actual concept follows frontal fire SHOCKWAVE with KNOCKBACK. Cast: planted forward open-palm push, hero stays grounded. Build: gold-red dragon brow gathers at palm. Release: shallow broad forward crest/wedge of dragon-shaped fire rolling outward along ground. Impact: forward flame crest breaks and enemies recoil away, show displacement through small arrows only in impact study. NOT flying hero, NOT airborne summon or homing projectile. Vignette low forward wave with readable width.
Keep each row a distinct silhouette: three needlelike palms / single compact dragon-coil bomb / low spreading dragon crest. All 5 requested stages must be present for each row.
corrections: Edit this skill concept sheet with one precise correction. Preserve every character design, pixel-art style, all other rows, lettering, layout and effects. ONLY fix the Hỏa Vân Chưởng top row: the RELEASE cell must contain EXACTLY THREE separate flame-palm projectiles TOTAL, all on ONE horizontal straight line in front of the palm, numbered 1 2 3. Remove the extra fourth bolt below them. The GAME SCALE (APPROX) cell at top right must also contain EXACTLY THREE bolts on ONE straight horizontal line aimed toward ONE bandit, no fan spread, no branching, no extra sparks resembling projectiles, hero on left and untouched bandit silhouettes on right. These represent consecutive shots along one lane, not three targeted enemies. Keep three separate small impact examples in IMPACT cell as temporal examples. Everything outside those two cells stays unchanged.
